question: Should WhatsApp conversation debounce live inside the existing `groups` and `direct` maps, even though `groups["*"]` also widens group admission, or should this use a separate timing-only config shape?
rationale: The runtime seam is plausible, but choosing where this public config belongs affects access semantics, docs, and future cross-channel debounce design.

options.title: Approve current maps with docs and proof
options.body: Keep `groups.<id>.debounceMs` and `direct.<id>.debounceMs`, but require docs/UI help that clearly warn `groups["*"]` admits all groups plus live WhatsApp proof before merge.

options.title: Move to a timing-only map
options.body: Use a separate conversation debounce map so wildcard timing defaults cannot accidentally change group admission behavior.

options.title: Defer to the canonical issue
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54565 receives an explicit maintainer decision on scope and precedence.

recommendation.title: Approve current maps with docs and proof
recommendation.body: Keep `groups.<id>.debounceMs` and `direct.<id>.debounceMs`, but require docs/UI help that clearly warn `groups["*"]` admits all groups plus live WhatsApp proof before merge.
